notes.title: 2024年6月8日更新
notes.content:
加入了提示功能的灯泡图标，提示时间从300秒降低至60秒。
Added a light bulb icon with a reminder function, reducing the reminder time from 300 seconds to 60 seconds.

tags.feature: Added a light bulb icon with a reminder function

tags.balance_change: reducing the reminder time from 300 seconds to 60 seconds.

notes.title: 2023年11月29日更新
notes.content:
修复全图模式中左上角一只猫咪点不到的问题。
修复初次运行时点击灯泡按钮不生效的问题。
气泡提示时间从5秒提高到16秒。
重新命名了成就名称。

Fix the issue where a cat in the top left corner cannot be clicked in full image mode.
Fix the issue where clicking the light bulb button does not take effect during the first run.
The bubble prompt time has been increased from 5 seconds to 16 seconds.
Renamed the achievement name.

=============

以下为历史累计更新
动物图片和场景一样从2K升到4K了。（现在动物应该比之前更加清晰一些。）
设置了帧数上限。（中低端显卡应该不会有压力了。）
替换更清晰的图标
锁60帧（需要开垂直同步才能生效，但会出现拖影）
关闭垂直同步（锁帧失灵，左右横跳，纠结中）
目前状态是开着锁60，关着垂直同步，锁帧失灵中。
圣诞老人改成淡出淡入的过渡效果。
修正了点击过快，导致圣诞老人不染色的问题。
QE的缩放功能交换了位置，现在E是放大，Q是缩小。
现在计时器和教程菜单默认是显示，2个首页按钮改成了切换式。
微调了提示按钮的大小。
进一步优化了很多项调试秘籍。
以后会公布这些秘籍。
为键盘的WASD和上下左右加入了镜头移动，QE和上一页下一页加入了放大缩小。
加入提示功能，如间隔180秒没找到任何新物品，将会在计数器上显示灯泡按钮。
通关的动物喷泉特效在点击重新开始按钮时，现在会瞬间消失，避免遮挡。
优化了N条调试秘籍。
修正1处图和点击判定位置错位的问题。
缩小点击气泡特效的尺寸。
首启动时，键位教程更加明显。
圣诞老人出现时机稍加间隔时间。
姜饼人不再默认是灰色。

The following are historical cumulative updates
Animal images and scenes have been upgraded from 2K to 4K, just like the scenes. (Animals should be clearer now than before.)
The frame rate limit has been set. (Low end graphics cards should not be under pressure anymore.)
Replace clearer icons
Lock 60 frames (requires vertical synchronization to take effect, but dragging may occur)
Turn off vertical synchronization (lock frame failure, left and right lateral jumps, entanglement)
The current status is lock 60 on, vertical synchronization off, and lock frame failure.
Santa Claus has been changed to a transition effect of fading out and in.
Fixed the issue of Santa Claus not staining due to clicking too quickly.
QE's zoom function has swapped positions, now E is zooming in and Q is zooming out.
Now the timer and tutorial menu are displayed by default, and the two homepage buttons have been changed to toggle.
Fine tuned the size of the prompt button.
Further optimized many debugging secrets.
These secrets will be announced in the future.
Added camera movement for keyboard WASD and up, down, left, and right, and added zoom in and out for QE and previous and next pages.
Add a prompt function, if no new item is found after a 180 second interval, a light bulb button will be displayed on the counter.
The Animal Fountain special effect that has been cleared will now disappear instantly when the restart button is clicked to avoid obstruction.
Optimized N debugging secrets.
Fix the issue of misalignment in one image and click judgment position.
Reduce the size of the bubble effect when clicking.
At the initial startup, the keyway tutorial becomes more prominent.
Santa Claus appears at slightly different times.
Gingerbread Man no longer defaults to gray.
